newsitem.title: RUSSIA: German doctors to join Yeltsin heart team.
newsitem.headline: German doctors to join Yeltsin heart team.

text.p: Two leading German heart specialists will join the medical team preparing President Boris Yeltsin for surgery, the Kremlin press service said on Friday.
Chancellor Helmut Kohl offered the cardiologists' services in a telephone call on Friday and Yeltsin accepted, it said.

A German government statement issued in Bonn named the doctors as Axel Haverich, the director of a clinic for heart surgery at Hanover's Medical Technical College and Thorsten Wahlers who also worked at the clinic.

A council of doctors, including foreign specialists, is due to meet between September 27 and 29 to determine when Yeltsin, 65, will have his heart bypass operation. The German government statement did not say when the doctors were due to leave.

The Russian television channel NTV said pioneering U.S. heart surgeon Michael DeBakey, who will be in Moscow for a seminar, would join the team. But DeBakey said he had not yet been approached either to be a consultant or to operate.
Kohl visited Yeltsin near Moscow on Saturday and the two leaders describe themselves as personal friends.
"B.N. Yeltsin expressed his thanks for the suggestion and agreed to include the German specialists in the work of the Russian cardiologists," the Kremlin said in a statement.
